## Download

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| **PD2-Mod-Manager-Setup.exe** | **Recommended.** Installs the manager with a Start menu shortcut and an uninstaller. No admin rights needed. |
| PD2-Mod-Manager-Portable.zip | No install. Unzip anywhere and run `pd2-mod-manager.exe`. |

### Install
1. Download **PD2-Mod-Manager-Setup.exe** and run it.
2. If Windows shows **"Windows protected your PC"**, click **More info → Run anyway**. This appears for any new app that isn't code-signed.
3. Open **PD2 Mod Manager** from the Start menu. It finds your Epic or Steam copy of PAYDAY 2 by itself.

Need SuperBLT or BeardLib? Settings has one-click installs for both.

## What it does
- Browse and one-click install mods from **ModWorkshop** and **Nexus Mods**, with required mods added automatically.
- Puts every mod in the right folder (`mods`, `mod_overrides`, `Maps`, game root, Battle Announcers packs) and repairs ones in the wrong place.
- Enable, disable, tag, update-check and uninstall your mods.
- **Share your setup:** a short modpack code (like `PD2-DmfECBsUfgREI8Z4klsYhq6miTNpCIBdg`), or a zip with all the files that friends drag onto the manager.
- NSFW filter on by default.

Settings and your mod list are kept in `%APPDATA%\PD2ModManager`. Uninstalling the app leaves your mods and settings alone.
